blocks.text: Level examination B2
Instructions
The examination checks the objectives of the Level B2 in five sections. It takes place in the week 253, in three half days:
• day 1: A · Read (75 minutes), B · Listening (45 minutes), with 15 minute pause;
• day 2: C · Translation (70 minutes), D · Writing (100 minutes), with 15 minute pause;
• day 3: E · Oral with tutor (about 25 minutes, more 10 preparation).

rows: Reading: a news article or policy article, an opinion article, four titles (without vowels)
Listening: an interview, a debate with switching, a song in Egyptian, a dictation
Translation: from Arabic to English (about 200 words) and from English to Arabic (about 70 words)
Writing: an argumentative text (about 300 words) and a neutral synthesis (about 150 words)
Oral: fuṣḥā spoken (exposition, discussion, report) and Egyptian

the interaction and register do not self-evaluate: without tutor the section remains open and the examination is not concluded.
• Work without notes. The dictionary (by root, and an Italian dictionary) is only allowed in section C.
Just correct it at the end.
• Reading speed. In section A, read the article A1 once in silence with the stopwatch and note the

time: the end-of-level objective is at least 90 words per minute. Speed doesn't enter the score, but it goes into the log. What the result attests. A pass says you mastered the program. B2 of this course. It is not a CEFR certification, even if the reference level is the B2. For external feedback, in front of an independent examiner, see the certifications listed in Appendix C. If you don't pass the exam. Identify the sections below the minimum and follow the recovery path (table at the bottom of the solutions) for 3–5 weeks. Then repeat only those sections with Version B, at the end of this exam: don't look at it first. If you fail the same section again, repeat the module that contains it.
